title: Commonwealth Engine Fixes (CEF): what it does, which game version, and using it with Addictol or Buffout 4
content:
Commonwealth Engine Fixes (CEF): what it does, which game version, and using it with Addictol or Buffout 4
Commonwealth Engine Fixes (CEF, Nexus Mods) is a set of F4SE plugins for Fallout 4 (needs F4SE and Address Library):
- FCStruct2.dll, FaceGen optimizer: retries a failed NPC face paint once and falls back to a plain face instead of a "rust face"; paints more face steps per frame; reuses face texture arrays (uses extra video memory, released automatically when free video memory drops below 1024 MB). Using pre-made FaceGen files for every NPC is OFF by default because generic settlers then go bald.
- FCShadow2.dll: spreads the sun-shadow culling of pre-culled (previs) areas over the game's helper threads, with the same shadows as the game's own code.
- CEFCrashLog.dll: crash logger; writes Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\CEF-Crash-<date>_<time>.log.
Game version: FCStruct2 and FCShadow2 patch only Fallout 4 1.11.240 (they check F4SE's runtime version and the exe's build stamp and size). On any other build they load and patch nothing.
In game: F6 switches FCStruct2 on/off, F7 FCShadow2 (iToggleKey in their .ini files in Data\F4SE\Plugins). Their logs are FCStruct2.log and FCShadow2.log in the F4SE log folder: "installed" means active; "unexpected bytes ... not installing" means another mod already changed that spot in the game code and CEF left it alone.
With other stability mods: the CEF crash logger steps aside only when Buffout4.dll is loaded. With Addictol's crash logger (AddictolCrashLogger.dll) both would be active; keep one by setting bEnable=0 in CEFCrashLog.ini.
The two diagnostic tools (Run CEF Diagnostics.bat, Run Mod Doctor.bat) need Python 3, only read your files and write a report into the F4SE log folder with your Windows user name hidden.
The source is public on GitHub for review only (not open source: no re-uploads or modified versions). The author states it was made with AI and tested on one PC.
Mossy's Crash Log Analyzer reads CEF crash logs.
tags: commonwealth engine fixes cef fcstruct2 fcshadow2 cefcrashlog facegen optimizer shadow culling crash logger addictol buffout 4 f6 f7 toggle 1.11.240 unexpected bytes not installing bald settlers
verified_by: CEF 1.0.5a source read on GitHub (TheRealMBKYoungest/Commonwealth-Engine-Fixes) 2026-11-05: README, LICENSE, cef_version.h version gate, the three plugin .cpp/.ini files (CheckCall byte check before patching, Buffout4.dll stand-down, ini defaults), tools (no network or program-launch code). Addictol crash logger DLL name seen in an Addictol install. Speed claims by the author not tested.

title: Faster Archives (Fallout 4): what it does, the "Repacked" mod, and how to tell from its log whether it is doing anything
content:
Faster Archives (Fallout 4): what it does, the "Repacked" mod, and how to tell from its log whether it is doing anything
Faster Archives (Nexus 110801) is an F4SE plugin (FasterArchives.dll) for game 1.11.240. It repacks archives from zlib to LZ4 and decodes LZ4 in the game, to make archive loading faster. Settings are in Data\F4SE\Plugins\FasterArchives.ini; your repack choice is also remembered in <game folder>\Faster Archives\remembered.ini.
iMode: 1 = back up the originals, 2 = replace them, 3 = put the repacked copies in a Mod Organizer mod called "Faster Archives - Repacked", 4-6 = replace the archives where they are under Mod Organizer or Vortex. With bRepackModArchives=1 it repacks your mods' archives too (the copies take about as much space again).
Rules for mode 3: tick both "Faster Archives" and "Faster Archives - Repacked" to play; the Repacked mod has to win over the archives it replaces (its log says "enable that mod, last in the list" when it does not). Untick both for the Creation Kit and other archive tools, which cannot read LZ4 (see the Creation Kit 'Bad inflate' crash entry).
Is it working? Open Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\FasterArchives.log after playing:
- "LZ4 decoder installed over inflate ... (0 repacked archives in the load order)" and "SUMMARY ... 0 LZ4 entries decoded" mean the game read none of the repacked copies, so there is no speed-up yet.
- "202 waiting for the MO2 mod" and "X is repacked in the MO2 mod, but the game reads <path>" mean the copies exist but the game still opened the originals.
- "223 already repacked, 0 waiting for the MO2 mod" means the copies are in use.
Under Mod Organizer it may say "Mod Organizer is not among this process's parents ... checking running ones": it then guesses the instance and profile, and names the modlist.txt it read ("enabled mods read from ...\profiles\<name>\modlist.txt"). Check that this is the profile you actually started the game from.
tags: faster archives lz4 repack fasterarchives.ini imode faster archives repacked mod organizer bRepackModArchives FasterArchives.log 0 LZ4 entries decoded waiting for the MO2 mod archive loading speed
verified_by: Faster Archives 1.0.7's own FasterArchives.ini comments (iMode values, bRepackModArchives, remembered.ini) and three real FasterArchives.log files from a real game setup on 2026-11-09 (11:52 and 11:58: 0 LZ4 entries decoded, 202 waiting for the MO2 mod; 14:14: 223 already repacked, 0 waiting).

title: Faster Decompression does nothing when Addictol is installed ("FastDecompress inactive ... no hooks installed")
content:
Faster Decompression does nothing when Addictol is installed ("FastDecompress inactive ... no hooks installed")
Faster Decompression (Nexus 102435, 0FastDecompress.dll) replaces the game's zlib decompression. Addictol already does the same (its [Patches] bLibDeflate, on by default). With both installed, Faster Decompression 1.4.2 steps aside. Its log (Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\FastDecompress.log) says:
[info] Addictol 1.8.0.0 detected: effective [Patches] bLibDeflate=true
[error] FastDecompress inactive: zlib contract changed or another mod owns a required function (RVA 7860); no hooks installed
[warning] FastDecompress loaded inactive; game decompression was left unchanged
Nothing breaks, but it gives no benefit next to Addictol, so it can be removed. Similarly, check a performance plugin's own .ini before judging it: Faster File Copy (Nexus 103703) does nothing while its FasterFileCopyFO4.ini has bEnabled=false (its log then says "plugin effects disabled; hooks remain pass-through").
tags: faster decompression 0FastDecompress FastDecompress inactive no hooks installed addictol bLibDeflate libdeflate zlib faster file copy bEnabled false performance plugins overlap
verified_by: Real FastDecompress.log and FasterFileCopyFO4.log from a real game setup (Addictol 1.8.0.0, F4SE 0.7.9, game 1.11.240), 2026-11-09; lines quoted verbatim.

title: Game crashes on start and f4se.log says "couldn't load plugin 1114" for many plugins at once: reinstall Address Library
content:
Game crashes on start and f4se.log says "couldn't load plugin 1114" for many plugins at once: reinstall Address Library
Symptom: the game closes while starting. In Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\f4se.log several unrelated plugins fail at the same time, for example:
plugin Addictol.dll (00000001 Addictol 01080000) couldn't load plugin 1114 (handle 1)
plugin BakaFramework.dll (...) couldn't load plugin 1114
plugin F4SEMenuFramework.dll (...) disabled, fatal error occurred while loading plugin 0
and the log stops partway down the plugin list. Windows' Application event log shows a crash in each of those DLLs within a few seconds.
1114 is the Windows error "a dynamic link library (DLL) initialization routine failed": the DLL started to load and failed while setting itself up. When many plugins fail like this together while others load normally, look at what they share. On 2026-11-09 the failing ones (Addictol, Actor Velocity Framework, Baka Framework, Faster Cell Lookup, Dynamic Texture LOD, Faster Shadows) all use Address Library for F4SE Plugins (Data\F4SE\Plugins\version-1-11-240-0.bin). Reinstalling Address Library replaced that file (8,833,720 bytes before, 10,436,904 bytes after) and the next start loaded all 30 plugins correctly.
So: when f4se.log shows 1114 on several plugins, reinstall Address Library for F4SE Plugins for your game version first, then start the game once and check that the plugins say "loaded correctly".
tags: f4se.log couldn't load plugin 1114 dll initialization failed fatal error occurred while loading plugin game crashes on startup address library version-1-11-240-0.bin reinstall f4se plugins fail at once
verified_by: a real f4se.log and Windows Application event log, 2026-11-09 (game 1.11.240, F4SE 0.7.9): 6 plugins with 1114 and 2 with 'fatal error' on every start from 14:02 to 14:14; after reinstalling Address Library the 14:25 start had 0 failures and 30 'loaded correctly'. Error text for 1114 is Windows' ERROR_DLL_INIT_FAILED.
